- Build a complete, playable mobile open-world fishing game.
- Add an aquarium for collected fish, expand the fish roster, and make fishing fights harder.

## Requirements
- Include fishing, selling, gear upgrades, virtual gamepad controls, catch-boosting bait, randomized gear, loot caches, multiple biomes, and rare fish variants.

- The game is a self-contained browser experience with an illustrated canvas world.

- Implemented the base game in `index.html`, `style.css`, and `game.js`: six biomes, fishing, selling, upgrades, bait, gear caches, journal, quest, and keyboard/mobile controls.

- `game.js`: Fish roster, aquarium inventory/panels, fishing, fight mechanics, world, and controls.
- `style.css`: Game presentation and responsive controls; needs styles for new aquarium/fight UI.

- Changes are uncommitted.
